524	def record_diff(checkout: Path, run_dir: Path) -> dict[str, Any]:
525	    """What the run left in the checkout: diff.patch, and the three numbers about it."""
526	    # -z so a path with a space or a quote survives; -uall so a new directory is listed as files.
527	    status = git(checkout, "status", "--porcelain", "-z", "--untracked-files=all")

379	class Wire:
380	    """The raw HTTP record: one line per attempt, request and response, with no secret in it."""
381	
382	    def __init__(self, path: Path, transport: Any = None):
383	        self.path = path
384	        self.attempts = 0
385	        path.touch()
386	        self.client = httpx2.AsyncClient(
387	            transport=transport,
388	            event_hooks={"request": [self.on_request], "response": [self.on_response]},
389	        )
390	
391	    def _write(self, **entry: Any) -> None:
392	        with self.path.open("a", encoding="utf-8") as f:
393	            f.write(json.dumps({"t": round(time.time(), 3), **entry}, ensure_ascii=False) + "\n")
394	
395	    @staticmethod
396	    def _body(text: str) -> Any:
397	        """A body that parses as JSON is recorded as the parsed value, so reading the record needs
398	        no second json.loads; a body that does not parse as JSON stays the text it was."""
399	        try:
400	            return json.loads(text)
401	        except ValueError:  # not JSON: keep the text, as the only thing it can be read as
402	            return text
403	
404	    def _headers(self, headers: Any) -> dict[str, str]:
405	        """Which headers were sent, never what the secret ones said."""
406	        out = {}
407	        for name, value in headers.items():
408	            name = name.lower()
409	            out[name] = "<redacted>" if name in SECRET_HEADERS else value
410	        return out

412	    async def on_request(self, request: Any) -> None:
413	        """Every attempt the SDK makes, headers and body included; the key is never written."""
414	        self.attempts += 1
415	        try:
416	            body = request.content.decode("utf-8", "replace")
417	        except Exception:  # a streamed body has nothing to record
418	            body = ""
419	        self._write(
420	            dir="request",
421	            method=request.method,
422	            url=str(request.url),
423	            status=None,
424	            headers=self._headers(request.headers),
425	            body=self._body(body),
426	        )

428	    async def on_response(self, response: Any) -> None:
429	        """The answer to it, read in full so the body is there even when the SDK streams."""
430	        await response.aread()
431	        req = response.request
432	        self._write(
433	            dir="response",
434	            method=req.method,
435	            url=str(req.url),
436	            status=response.status_code,
437	            headers=self._headers(response.headers),
438	            body=self._body(response.text),

526	    three numbers about it."""

528	    status = git(checkout, "status", "--porcelain", "-z", "--untracked-files=all")
529	    untracked = [entry[3:] for entry in status.split("\0") if entry.startswith("?? ")]
